title: Tuesday's deals: Lego advent calendars from £17.99, a £49.99 Millennium Falcon and a Dyson V15 price check
description: Lego's 2026 advent calendars are cheaper than last week, plus a Millennium Falcon at a third off and why to hold off on Dyson for now.
intro:
Today is mostly a Lego day. Amazon has cut the 2026 Lego advent calendars below their RRP, and the Star Wars and City ones are now **a pound or so cheaper than they were a week ago**. Advent calendars are only useful if they arrive before 1 December and they tend to sell out rather than get cheaper, so these are worth buying now.

A few popular Lego sets are also 25–33% off, which is about as good as Lego gets outside Black Friday. Dyson is the opposite story: prices are down, but last year's Black Friday prices were lower still, so wait unless you need one now. Prices were checked on 19 and 20 October.

deals.name: Lego Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026 (75456)
deals.note: £1 cheaper than a week ago and £7 under RRP. Twenty-four mini builds for a Star Wars fan.

deals.name: Lego Marvel Super Heroes Advent Calendar 2026 (76340)
deals.note: £6 off, and it was out of stock at Lego's own shop when we checked, so don't count on it hanging around.

deals.name: Lego City Advent Calendar 2026 (60510)
deals.note: The cheapest of the Lego calendars and a little lower than last week. A good one for younger builders.

deals.name: Lego Disney Princess Advent Calendar 2026 (43298)
deals.note: £6 off the RRP. Same deal as the others: buy it while it's in stock.

deals.name: Lego Star Wars Millennium Falcon (75375)
deals.note: A third off the smaller display Falcon. It has dipped to about £45 in the last three months, so this is good rather than a record.

deals.name: Lego Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle: The Main Tower (76454)
deals.note: £70 off a big Christmas-present set. 30% off is at the top end of what Lego usually goes for.

deals.name: Lego City Police Station (60316)
deals.note: 25% off a set that's expected to be retired at the end of this year, so it may get harder to find, not cheaper.

deals.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute with detail cleaning kit
deals.note: The £699.99 'was' includes an add-on kit; the plain V15 is usually about £650. It dropped to around £450–£480 last Black Friday, so hold on if you can.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

For the Lego sets, not really: 25–33% off is roughly what Lego's own Black Friday discounts looked like last year, and popular sets can sell out. Our new [Lego Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide has the prices to aim for and the sets retiring this year.

For Dyson, yes. Most models are a little above last November's prices, and Dyson usually starts its sale weeks early. See [Dyson Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) for the target price on each model, and [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now, what to wait for, and the traps to avoid](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) for everything else.
